capabilities: List notes grouped by shared tag sets
Sort related notes by file name, creation time, or modification time
Show folder path and first-paragraph summary for related notes
Exclude ignored tags from grouping via an ignore list
Search a tag in global search by clicking it
extras: Installable only through BRAT or manual file placement, not through the community plugin browser; README includes a detailed privacy section explaining that the plugin enumerates all Markdown file paths in the vault on each refresh.
problem: Obsidian shows which notes use a tag, but not which notes share a tag set with the note you are currently reading.
summary: Sidebar panel plugin that lists notes sharing tags with the current note, grouped by shared tag sets.
